note: Country cards (Countries mode): the head shliach of a country inside a shetach that spans several countries, shown under the shetach's own head (owner, Oct 7: 'who is head shliach of that country with head of shetach on top of him'). Each country gives the chabad.org center id of its own national center; the person shown is the owner's rule for any center: the first living man listed there on chabad.org (web/data/centers.geojson personnel), so it follows chabad.org's listing and its Hebrew comes from data/hebrew. Not listed: a country where the shetach's head is based (DRC, Puerto Rico, Thailand…), a country that is a whole shetach, a country split between shetachim, and a country with no center of its own on chabad.org (the shetach's head serves it). Two picks (Oct 8): the Dominican Republic's national center in Santo Domingo, not the regional house in Puerto Plata; Nigeria's national center in Abuja, not the Lagos city rabbi. Albania is Yoel Kaplan's own (Chief Rabbi of Albania, from Thessaloniki), so no line. Belarus (Oct 10): the owner put it in Lazar's Russia shetach (Chabadpedia: Belarus's shluchim work in coordination with Lazar); Shneur Deitch, Chabad of Minsk, is its own head. Mainland China has ten centers and no country-level head on chabad.org, so none until the owner names one.
